description_en: Adds a data source under the bound multi-cloud account

kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem add-data-source --account-id 123xxxxxxxx --data-source-type obs --data-source-instance-name 'XX北京kafka' --data-source-instance-remark 'XX云云防火墙上海实例' --data-source-instance-params '[{"paraCode":"region_code","paraValue":"ap-guangzhou"}]' --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
obs: Huawei Cloud OBS.
wafApi: Tencent Cloud WAF download API. 
ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值：
obs：华为云obs。
wafApi：腾讯云waf下载api。 
ckafka： 腾讯云ckafka
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The data source parameters in JSON array format
parameters.name: data_source_instance_params

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud provider
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Select the management center region based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets are located in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Count.description_en: The number of data sources that are added. A value of 1 indicates success. A value less than or equal to 0 indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 添加数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 添加数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。

DataSourceInstanceId.description_en: The data source ID, which is an MD5 hash generated by threat analysis based on the specific parameters
